title: Go Birds! Daily, June 2nd: Howie Roseman explains why the Eagles traded AJ Brown
text: Good morning! Start your day with Go Birds! Daily, a daily Eagles podcast giving you everything you need to know for June 2nd. In today’s episode Eliot Shorr-Parks dives into everything Howie Roseman had to say about why the Eagles traded AJ Brown.
